map.多维度分数计算、成绩分析、目标规划: Multi-dimensional score calculation, grade analysis and target planning

map.得分 = 正确题数 × 每题分值（或 正确率 × 总分）；通过线 = 总分 ×: Score = correct answers × marks per question (or accuracy × total score); pass line = total score × pass ratio; accuracy = correct answers ÷ total questions × 100%.

map.📚 深度解析：按各题或各模块得分汇总总分、折算百分制与等级，辅助成绩核算。: 📚 In-depth: totals the marks for each question or module, converts to a percentage scale and to grades, helping tally exam results.
map.总分汇总：多题得分相加。: Total: adds up the marks from every question.
map.百分折算：按满分换算。: Percentage conversion: rescales against the full marks.
map.等级：映射 ABCD 等。: Grades: mapped onto A, B, C, D and so on.
map.示例：卷面 120 分制得 96，折算百分制 80。: Example: 96 on a paper marked out of 120 converts to 80 out of 100.
map.录入各科满分再折算，避免量纲混乱。: Enter each subject's full marks before converting to avoid mixing scales.
map.按阈值映射，可自定义。: Mapped by thresholds that you can customize.
